preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= int(line.split()[1]) <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N+1])
preconditions.description: For each row specification, L[i] and R[i] satisfy 1 ≤ L[i] ≤ R[i] ≤ N, where N is the first integer in stdin.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N and 1 <= int(y) <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+2:N+2+Q] if (x, y) := tuple(map(int, line.split())))
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y) satisfies 1 ≤ x, y ≤ N, where Q is the integer on the line after the N row specifications.
Input consists of exactly N+2 lines for specifications, followed by Q+1 lines for queries and Q.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['E', 'O'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of stdout is either 'E' (even) or 'O' (odd), corresponding to the parity of the sum of the matrix after removing the x-th row and y-th column for each query.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (sum_matrix := sum(sum(1 for j in range(1, N+1) if L[i-1] <= j <= R[i-1]) for i in range(1, N+1)) - (sum(1 for j in range(1, N+1) if L[x-1] <= j <= R[x-1]) if x <= N else 0) - (sum(1 for i in range(1, N+1) if L[i-1] <= y <= R[i-1]) if y <= N else 0) + (1 if x <= N and y <= N and L[x-1] <= y <= R[x-1] else 0)) % 2 == 0 if stdout_line.strip() == 'E' else 1 for stdout_line, (x, y) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [(int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+2:N+2+Q] if (x, y) := tuple(map(int, line.split()))]))
postconditions.description: For each query (x, y), the parity of the sum of the matrix after removing the x-th row and y-th column is correctly computed as follows: the total sum of all 1s in the matrix is the sum over all rows of (R[i] - L[i] + 1), then subtract the sum of 1s in the x-th row (if x is valid), subtract the sum of 1s in the y-th column (if y is valid), and add back 1 if the removed cell (x, y) was originally 1 (i.e., if y is in [L[x-1], R[x-1]]). The parity of this value determines the output ('E' for even, 'O' for odd).
